definitions.explanation: Indicates that a situation continues unchanged from before.
Continuing in the same state without change.

examples.japanese: {相変|あいか}わらず⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
{相変|あいか}わらず⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: It's popular as always, isn't it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相変|あいか}わらず⟦{明|あか}るくて→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{優|やさ}しかった→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧。
examples.english: I saw her after a long time, and she was cheerful and kind as always.

examples.japanese: {相変|あいか}わらず⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相変|あいか}わらず⟦{忙|いそが}しそうだ→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。

⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦{経|た}っても→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相変|あいか}わらず⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Even after all these years, that shop still has a long line.

notes:
{相変|あいか}わらず indicates something continues unchanged.

POSITION: Usually placed at the beginning of a clause or before adjectives/verbs.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {相変|あいか}わらず + adjective/verb
- {相変|あいか}わらず⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun

USAGE:
Can have neutral, positive, or slightly negative connotations depending on context. Sometimes implies 'same old, same old.'

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{通|どお}り→どおり：09884_doori⟧: as usual (neutral)
- {相変|あいか}わらず: as always (slightly stronger continuity)
